command:
set -eu
tmp_conf=$(mktemp /etc/valkey/.inventory.conf.XXXXXX)
{
  printf 'bind 127.0.0.1 %s -::1\n' "$NODE_IP"
  printf 'protected-mode yes\n'
  printf 'port 6379\n'
  printf 'dir /var/lib/valkey/\n'
  printf 'dbfilename dump.rdb\n'
  printf 'appendonly yes\n'
  printf 'appendfilename "appendonly.aof"\n'
  printf 'appenddirname "appendonlydir"\n'
  printf 'appendfsync everysec\n'
  printf 'aof-use-rdb-preamble yes\n'
  printf 'aclfile /etc/valkey/users.acl\n'
} > "$tmp_conf"
chown root:valkey "$tmp_conf"
chmod 640 "$tmp_conf"
mv "$tmp_conf" /etc/valkey/inventory.conf
if ! grep -qxF 'include /etc/valkey/inventory.conf' /etc/valkey/valkey.conf; then
  printf '\ninclude /etc/valkey/inventory.conf\n' >> /etc/valkey/valkey.conf

credential_mode=$(stat -c '%U:%G %a' /etc/redis-inventory.env)
[ "$pong" = PONG ]
[ "$identity" = inventory ]
[ "$marker" = inventory-persistence-proof-v1 ]
[ "$aof_enabled" = 1 ]
[ "$aof_status" = ok ]
[ "$credential_mode" = 'root:root 600' ]

set -eu
credential_mode=$(stat -c '%U:%G %a' /etc/redis-inventory.env)
password_chars=[REDACTED] -F= '$1=="REDIS_PASSWORD"{print length($2)}' /etc/redis-inventory.env)
[ "$credential_mode" = 'root:root 600' ]
[ "$password_chars" -eq 64 ]
. /etc/redis-inventory.env
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
out_of_scope=$(valkey-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" --user "$REDIS_USERNAME" --no-auth-warning SET unrelated:post-restart blocked 2>&1 || true)
case "$out_of_scope" in *NOPERM*) scope_result=denied ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
unset REDISCLI_AUTH REDIS_PASSWORD
unauthenticated=$(valkey-cli -h "$NODE_IP" -p "$REDIS_PORT" PING 2>&1 || true)
case "$unauthenticated" in *NOAUTH*) unauth_result=denied ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
printf 'credential_file=%s\ncredential_password_chars=[REDACTED] "$credential_mode" "$password_chars" "$scope_result" "$unauth_result"
printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_persistence_files:'
find /var/lib/valkey/appendonlydir -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%u:%g %m %s %f\n' | sort
test -s /var/lib/valkey/appendonlydir/appendonly.aof.manifest
